**使用服务端模式时客户端为可选项，默认情况下需要安装客户端。**
**始终必须安装服务端。** Adventure Bags（冒险战利品袋）是一款完全可自定义的战利品袋模组，让你能够轻松为整合包生成战利品，或者仅仅想让你的世界中拥有更多战利品。只需右键点击即可收获满满，满足你内心对战利品的渴望！ ### 主要特性 - 4 种稀有度等级 - 调整宝箱中各冒险袋的生成概率 - 自由添加或移除袋内战利品 - 支持固定数量与随机数量，兼容 NBT/组件格式 - 轻松添加或移除其他战利品表 - 可合成至更高稀有度（仅限完整功能模式） - 可在仅服务端模式下运行，客户端保持原版 ### 服务端功能是如何工作的 原理相当简单：如果在启动时将配置设为服务端模式，模组将不会加载新物品（否则通常会阻止原版客户端加入服务器），而是仅使用原版物品（可自定义），默认情况下为 4 种不同颜色的染料。这些物品会被添加到战利品表中，替代原有的冒险袋，但会附带自定义模型数据（Custom Model Data）和自定义名称。当玩家使用该物品时，模组会检查这些数据，以确保它是真正的袋子而非普通物品。这样一来，模组便能完全通过服务端运行，利用原版函数且不添加任何新数据。
内置战利品表
普通冒险袋 ``` "2-16 minecraft:moss_block", "16 minecraft:torch", "minecraft:chest", "1-8 minecraft:emerald", "1-16 minecraft:coal", "6-16 minecraft:arrow", "1-4 minecraft:amethyst_shard", "1-6 minecraft:raw_iron", "1-6 minecraft:raw_copper", "1-4 minecraft:raw_gold", "minecraft:iron_shovel", "minecraft:iron_helmet", "minecraft:iron_boots", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_porkchop", "minecraft:bucket", "16 minecraft:clay", "12 minecraft:feather", "6 minecraft:gunpowder", "4-8 minecraft:bread", "16 minecraft:string", "6 minecraft:leather", "2 minecraft:book", "2-4 minecraft:bone", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_cod", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_salmon", "2-6 minecraft:ink_sac", "1-4 minecraft:cocoa_beans", "minecraft:cake", "4-16 minecraft:cookie", "4-16 minecraft:melon_slice", "2-12 minecraft:dried_kelp", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_beef", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_chicken", "1-4 minecraft:experience_bottle", "4-8 minecraft:baked_potato", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_rabbit", "minecraft:iron_horse_armor", "minecraft:name_tag", "minecraft:lead", "4-8 minecraft:cooked_mutton" ```
稀有冒险袋 ``` "minecraft:spore_blossom", "minecraft:emerald_block", "1-4 minecraft:hay_block", "minecraft:saddle", "2-6 minecraft:iron_ingot", "2-6 minecraft:copper_ingot", "1-4 minecraft:gold_ingot", "minecraft:iron_chestplate", "minecraft:iron_leggings", "minecraft:iron_pickaxe", "minecraft:iron_sword", "minecraft:iron_hoe", "minecraft:iron_axe", "minecraft:golden_apple", "1-4 minecraft:slime_ball", "2-8 minecraft:glowstone_dust", "1-3 minecraft:ender_pearl", "1-3 minecraft:blaze_rod", "1-3 minecraft:ghast_tear", "1-3 minecraft:magma_cream", "2-4 minecraft:pumpkin_pie", "4-12 minecraft:firework_rocket", "minecraft:golden_horse_armor", "1-4 minecraft:chorus_fruit", "minecraft:nautilus_shell", "minecraft:brush" ```
史诗冒险袋 ``` "minecraft:lapis_block", "1-2 minecraft:diamond", "minecraft:diamond_helmet", "minecraft:diamond_boots", "minecraft:diamond_axe", "minecraft:diamond_shovel", "minecraft:diamond_hoe", "minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple", "minecraft:blaze_spawn_egg", "minecraft:cave_spider_spawn_egg", "minecraft:creeper_spawn_egg", "minecraft:drowned_spawn_egg", "minecraft:enderman_spawn_egg", "minecraft:endermite_spawn_egg", "minecraft:skeleton_spawn_egg", "minecraft:witch_spawn_egg", "minecraft:wither_skeleton_spawn_egg", "minecraft:zombie_spawn_egg", "minecraft:dragon_head", "minecraft:diamond_horse_armor", "minecraft:heart_of_the_sea", "1-3 minecraft:echo_shard", "1-3 minecraft:frogspawn", "1-6 minecraft:coal_ore", "minecraft:diamond_ore", "1-4 minecraft:redstone_ore", "1-6 minecraft:gold_ore", "1-8 minecraft:iron_ore", "1-4 minecraft:lapis_ore", "1-4 minecraft:emerald_ore" ```
传说冒险袋 ``` "minecraft:spawner", "1-3 minecraft:netherite_scrap", "minecraft:diamond_sword", "minecraft:diamond_pickaxe", "minecraft:diamond_chestplate", "minecraft:diamond_leggings", "minecraft:skeleton_skull", "minecraft:wither_skeleton_skull", "minecraft:player_head", "minecraft:zombie_head", "minecraft:creeper_head", "minecraft:piglin_head", "minecraft:nether_star", "minecraft:end_crystal", "minecraft:dragon_breath", "minecraft:trident", "minecraft:totem_of_undying", "minecraft:budding_amethyst", "minecraft:dragon_egg", "minecraft:diamond_block", "1-3 minecraft:iron_block", "1-2 minecraft:gold_block", "minecraft:netherite_ingot" ```
配置设置 配置过程相当简单。如果你只玩原版，默认情况下无需过多操作。直接使用默认设置即可，它们会确保使用上述内置战利品表。 不过，如果你正在制作整合包，可能希望自定义配置以加入其他模组的物品。这同样很简单。你可以使用 Mod Menu 集成（推荐），或直接编辑配置文件。若要将新物品添加到袋子的战利品表中，你需要知道该物品的命名空间（Namespace）和物品 ID，例如 `minecraft:diamond_block` 代表来自 minecraft 命名空间的钻石块。 #### 袋子战利品表 袋子战利品表支持以下格式：`(最小数量)-(最大数量) [命名空间:物品ID](NBT数据)`，其中 `()` 内的内容为可选，`[]` 内的内容为必填（数量和组件为可选，物品 ID 必填）。
v2.0.0 及以上版本采用自定义数据处理方式。你可以使用此[网站](https://a5ho9999.github.io/AdventureBagsTool/)
v2.0.0 以下版本需要使用 1.20.4 的 NBT 格式，你可以使用 [McStacker](https://mcstacker.net/1.20.3.php)。网站上的 `/give` 选项会生成正确的数据。直接复制输出内容即可（仅复制物品 ID 之后的 NBT 数据部分。复制全部内容会导致无效条目）。
#### 示例： - `minecraft:diamond_block` - 1 个钻石块 - `3 minecraft:diamond_block` - 3 个钻石块 - `1-8 minecraft:diamond_block` - 在 1 到 8 个钻石块之间随机生成（包含 1 和 8） - (v2.0.0+) `minecraft:diamond_sword{"name":"Shiny Blue Thing"}` - 一把名为“Shiny Blue Thing”的钻石剑 - `minecraft:diamond_block{display:{Name:'{"text":"Shiny Blue Thing"}'}}` - 一个名为“Shiny Blue Thing”的钻石块 #### 生成战利品表 设置袋子生成的包含与排除战利品表也十分简单。只需将战利品表路径放入列表即可。战利品表必须位于 `data/[命名空间]/loot_table/` 文件夹内。例如 `chests/simple_dungeon`，其对应文件路径为 `data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/simple_dungeon.json`。这也适用于任何模组战利品表（不仅限于 chests 文件夹）。 #### 袋子生成概率 你可以调整袋子在战利品表中的生成稀有度，数值范围为 1.0 到 0.0（最低可设为 0.00001）。1.0 代表 100%，而 0.0 代表几乎不生成（或在不将其完全从列表中移除的前提下尽可能接近 0）。默认值为：普通 0.8（80%）、稀有 0.4（40%）、史诗 0.15（15%）和传说 0.08（8%）。 #### 服务端选项 上文已对此作了大部分说明，但逻辑同样直白。切换到仅服务端模式后，模组将不会加载任何超出原版的自定义/额外数据，从而避免正常的注册表冲突问题。它会使用选项下方指定的物品作为冒险袋，并通过自定义名称和模型数据来确保其与默认原版物品区分开来。若提供的物品无效，则默认回退至彩色染料。 *即使输入有误游戏仍可正常运行，它仅会在日志中打印无效输入的报错信息。因此若未得到预期结果，请务必查阅日志。你可在配置文件中启用调试模式（需在文件中手动将其设置为 true）以获取更多信息。*
配置示例 示例配置文件位于 `config/adventure-loot.json5` ```json { "Debug": false, "DefaultOptions": "Disabled", "CommonChance": 0.8, "RareChance": 0.4, "EpicChance": 0.15, "LegendaryChance": 0.08, "CommonLoot": [ "minecraft:moss_block", "12 minecraft:diamond", "4-9 minecraft:gold_ingot ", "minecraft:diamond_chestplate{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"fancy chestplate\"}'},Enchantments:[{id:\"minecraft:protection\",lvl:69s}]}", "minecraft:chest{BlockEntityTag:{Items:[{Slot:13b,id:\"minecraft:cake\",Count:1b,tag:{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Hoef\\'s Favourite\",\"color\":\"white\",\"bold\":true}',Lore:['{\"text\":\"Just a little squashed\",\"color\":\"light_purple\",\"italic\":true}']}}}],Lock:\"Flight Licence\"}}" ], "RareLoot": [ "40 minecraft:iron_ingot" ], "EpicLoot": [ "9-64 minecraft:diamond" ], "LegendaryLoot": [ "minecraft:diamond_chestplate" ], "TablesToExclude": [ "chests/simple_dungeon", "chests/village/village_mason" ], "TablesToAdd": [ "entities/cow" ], "ServerSideOnly": false, "ServerSideCommonItem": "minecraft:white_dye", "ServerSideRareItem": "minecraft:blue_dye", "ServerSideEpicItem": "minecraft:red_dye", "ServerSideLegendaryItem": "minecraft:purple_dye" } ```
*欢迎在整合包中使用本模组，但请仅在 Modrinth 生态内提供下载链接，切勿重新上传或转载。*
